edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from address into _transfer.
msg.sender is used as the sender of the public transfer entrypoint.
msg.sender is compared to _owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender must equal _feeAddrWallet for manualswap to execute.
msg.sender must equal _feeAddrWallet for manualsend to execute.
block.timestamp governs the cooldown[to] comparison and update, making transfers timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
cooldown mapping is read and written to enforce per-address trade cooldowns in _transfer.
_maxTxAmount is enforced as the transfer amount ceiling in _transfer.
_maxWalletSize is enforced as the recipient balance ceiling in _transfer.
bots blacklist is checked before allowing transfers in _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFee is checked to decide fee and swap behaviour in _transfer.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to classify buy and sell transfers.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap and ETH send branch inside _transfer.
cooldownEnabled gates the cooldown and limit enforcement branch inside _transfer.
The from parameter flows through _transfer logic and state checks.
The to parameter flows through _transfer logic and state checks.
The amount parameter is compared against limits inside _transfer.
The locally computed contract token balance is passed as tokenAmount to swapTokensForEth.
tokenAmount parameter is used as the swap input amount.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the external swap call in swapTokensForEth.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router call that can hand control to external code.
The router swap can call back into the contract (payable receive) before _transfer state accounting completes.
_feeAddrWallet is the recipient of the ETH sent in sendETHToFee.
The amount parameter of sendETHToFee flows into the external ETH transfer.
sendETHToFee triggers an external ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
The fee wallet ETH transfer occurs inside the swap branch of _transfer before token accounting finishes.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth when swap conditions hold.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee when the contract holds ETH.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom uses SafeMath sub on the allowance before approving the reduced value.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer which executes _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute fee and reflection values.
The local current rate is used by _getValues for reflection computations.
_rOwned balances of sender and recipient are updated inside _transferStandard.
The local reflection amount is subtracted from the sender balance in _transferStandard.
_transferStandard performs reflection balance arithmetic via SafeMath sub/add.
_rTotal feeds the rate and supply computations used by _getValues.
_feeAddr1 tax fee numerator is consumed by the fee value computation.
_feeAddr2 team fee numerator is consumed by the fee value computation.
openTrading calls external addLiquidityETH forwarding contract ETH.
openTrading calls the factory createPair function to deploy the pair.
openTrading grants max allowance to the router and the pair.
openTrading stores the newly created router instance in uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
openTrading sets cooldownEnabled to true.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount to the trading limit.
openTrading lowers _maxWalletSize to the trading limit.
openTrading is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
nonosquare is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
delBot is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
setCooldownEnabled is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
changeMaxTxAmount is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
changeMaxWalletSize is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
The owner check in onlyOwner compares _owner against msg.sender.
nonosquare writes blacklist entries into the bots mapping.
delBot clears blacklist entries in the bots mapping.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
changeMaxTxAmount writes the _maxTxAmount value derived from the percentage.
changeMaxWalletSize writes the _maxWalletSize value derived from the percentage.
The percentage parameter drives SafeMath mul/div to set the new max transaction amount.
The bots_ array parameter is iterated and written into the bots blacklist.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the full contract token balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee on the contract ETH balance.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from only exists to feed the core _transfer function logic.
Parameter to only exists to feed the core _transfer function logic.
The transfer amount parameter is only meaningful within _transfer.
tokenAmount is used solely as the swap input of swapTokensForEth.
Percentage is only used to compute the new max transaction amount.
The bots_ array is only consumed by the nonosquare blacklist loop.
The amount parameter is only used by the sendETHToFee external transfer.
The local balance is computed in _transfer and immediately passed to swapTokensForEth.
The local rate is a derived intermediate consumed by the reflection value computation.
The local reflection amount is a derived intermediate of _transferStandard accounting.
